thread:
Maria Chen: FYI we just got a security questionnaire from CloudBank asking for details on ephemeral access during incident response. they want evidence and a diagram — can we pull together answers?
Tom B.: which parts specifically? they usually want who can swap keys and how long sessions last.
Maria Chen: yep — RBAC change flow, audit log retention for incident snapshots, and KMS envelope signing/rotation proof. also a red-team finding attached that asks for mitigation timeline.
Raj Patel: I can pull the RBAC change history for the last 90 days. will need to know what scope CloudBank needs (tenant vs org).
Maria Chen: they asked for tenant-level access patterns + a playback of an incident escalation (pseudo-demo is fine).
Emily Walker: I recommend we redact tenant ids but include role mappings and step-by-step timestamped actions. devsec-bot can produce a condensed audit export.
devsec-bot: @Emily Walker started export job audit-export-179999-01 (eta ~2m). contains: role_changes, session_starts, kms_operations.
Sarah O.: for KMS proof we should include envelope metadata: key-id, wrapping-key-version, signature-verify steps. don't share raw ciphertext.
Tom B.: can someone remind me the CLI to list recent KMS envelopes? I always forget the flags.
Raj Patel: quick snippet: ```sh
redwood-cli kms envelope list --tenant <TENANT_ID> --since 2025-11-01 --fields key_id,version,operation
```
Tom B.: perfect, thanks. that gives what CloudBank will want.
Maria Chen: red-team finding summary: they were able to get a temporary support token from a stale service-account that had overly-broad roles. we fixed the account last week but they want timeline + root cause analysis.
Emily Walker: root cause = service-account not in ephemeral rotation policy + missing exp claim on token mint. mitigation = rotate, restrict scope, add exp enforcement in token service. I can draft RCA.
Sarah O.: also include the oncall runbook snippet for emergency revocation: ```sh
# revoke session
redwood-cli iam revoke-session --session-id SESS12345
# remove role binding
redwood-cli iam role remove --principal svc:old-sa --role infra-tenant-admin
```
Raj Patel: putting together the evidence packet: RBAC CSV, audit-export link (signed), KMS envelope manifest, RCA draft. will upload to shared folder.
Maria Chen: CloudBank asked whether we ship logs to their SIEM during an incident. current answer: we can stream audit logs to customer SIEM via S3/Push connector with signed snapshots. include config example.
Tom B.: config example for streaming: ```yaml
exporter:
  type: s3
  bucket: cb-security-uploads
  prefix: redwood/audit
  signing: true
```
Emily Walker: I'll join the review call tomorrow to walk through the demo playback. can someone prepare 5-10 minute slides showing the RBAC change -> token mint -> revocation timeline?
Raj Patel: slides + exported audit playback (JSONL) — I'll seed with fake tenant ids for demo.
Maria Chen: timeline: audit-export job done?
devsec-bot: audit-export-179999-01 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-sec-exports/1799991234/audit-179999-01.jsonl (signed).
Sarah O.: remember to include log retention policy statement: default 365d for audit events, 7y for enterprise customers on request.
Tom B.: should we redact IPs in playback? CloudBank asked about anonymization.
Emily Walker: keep source IPs but obfuscate last octet. note in packet how we redacted.
Maria Chen: OK I'll draft the email to CloudBank with attachments + the RCA and request for a short follow-up call. Sarah/Emily/Raj — can you review before send?
Sarah O.: will review, especially KMS sections.
Raj Patel: review too, I'll validate exported logs.
Tom B.: lmk if you want me to run the demo on call. happy to do it. :+1:
Maria Chen: thanks team — target to send by EOD PST.
Emily Walker: ack, will be available for last-minute edits.
devsec-bot: reminder scheduled: security-review-call with CloudBank at 2025-12-03T16:00Z.
Maria Chen: noted.
Tom B.: last note — include mention of policy that service accounts get auto-rotated every 24h by default moving forward. they'll want commitment.
Emily Walker: add a link to the policy doc: https://internal.redwood.dev/security/sa-rotation (internal).
Maria Chen: done — thanks all.
